name: Brunei Darussalam

findings.summary: Telekom Brunei, then the sole fixed operator, selected Huawei as exclusive turnkey supplier for its four-phase national FTTH next-generation broadband network, covering active and passive equipment and construction management.
findings.analyst_inference: Award is old; fixed access assets were later consolidated into UNN (2019) per general knowledge, not verified here. Whether Huawei optical equipment remains in service is unconfirmed.

findings.summary: UNN is refreshing its network core to edge using Juniper MX960 routers for its 100 Gbps backbone, SRX5800 security gateways and ACX2200 metro routers for RAN aggregation, alongside building a telco cloud ahead of 5G.
findings.analyst_inference: Covers IP backbone/aggregation only; the 5G radio vendor is not named in any source found.

findings.summary: Construction began on UNN's prefabricated data centre in Tungku, about 51,000 sq ft with 200 Vertiv-supplied racks and a second power feed from Berakas Power Company; opening was targeted for early 2024.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole coded domestic on the inference that UNN is Brunei state-linked (ownership not stated in the source). Current operational status not verified; a UNN groundbreaking page appeared in search results but was not read.

findings.local_actor: Unified National Networks (UNN); Ministry of Health
findings.summary: UNN announced AI GPU servers deployed in its Tier 3 colocation facility to host EVYD's data platform, billed as Brunei's first national AI application platform, initially a proof of concept serving the Ministry of Health and BruHealth.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: EVYD's ownership is not stated, and neither the GPU vendor nor any model is named. Proof-of-concept status coded tier 2. UNN release tiered S4 as corporate announcement.

findings.summary: Operator Imagine announced strategic partnerships with Toppan Ecquaria and Huawei Brunei, the Huawei tie-up aimed at network infrastructure, cloud readiness and digital solutions; no instrument type or financial terms disclosed.
findings.analyst_inference: Coded tier 1 because no contract or binding terms are described.

findings.summary: At a Bandar Seri Begawan summit Microsoft publicly committed to support Brunei's digital transformation across Azure cloud, AI, government services and cybersecurity; no MoU, contract or value was described.
findings.analyst_inference: Statement of intent only; cloud layer coded here as a gap-fill since no Brunei cloud region rows exist.

silicon.null_reason: UNN reports AI GPU servers deployed (Dec 2025) but no vendor, volume or export licence surfaced in 2 searches

models.null_reason: no national LLM or government frontier-model partnership found in 2 searches

power.null_reason: no AI-specific power evidence surfaced beyond a second feed for the UNN data centre
